theme: An open day built around one appointment and a booking backlog.
greeting: Morning, Dan. Just the 9:30 passport appointment sits on the calendar today — the rest is open, and the real pressure is the travel-booking pile ahead of Croatia.

needsAttention.title: Passport appointment for all four girls
needsAttention.detail: The four minor appointments are at 9:30 at the Gateway Mall post office — arrive 9:20. Turning up missing one document sends all four applications home, so the DS-11s, birth-certificate copies, and Jennifer's ID copies need to be in the packet before you leave.

needsAttention.title: Nautilus charter invoice is unpaid
needsAttention.detail: QuickBooks flagged invoice 2170 to Nautilus Sailing, $6,475 balance due, as still outstanding — it's the Croatia charter, so it wants clearing before the trip.

needsAttention.title: Croatia checked bags aren't confirmed
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags on Basic Economy for twelve days plus a week sailing. Confirm the allowance on Eurowings Discover's own site with the record locator and buy bags online now — counter fees run far higher, and it has to be settled before the Sept 8 departure.

needsAttention.title: Disney park tickets for your six
needsAttention.detail: Rooms are covered by the Orlando villa, but the Sept 26–27 park tickets for your six are the piece with the hard wall now — check whether the ticket type needs park reservations.

needsAttention.title: St Pete gap nights, Sept 20–22
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA from Croatia Sunday the 20th, but the girls aren't picked up until Tuesday the 22nd — two nights in the St Pete area still need booking before the Orlando villa starts.

schedule.title: Passport appointment — 4 girls
schedule.detail: Gateway Mall post office, arrive 9:20, about an hour

flagged.title: Nautilus charter invoice unpaid
flagged.detail: QuickBooks reminder: invoice 2170, $6,475 balance due to Nautilus Sailing.

flagged.title: Tim Soley accepted your LinkedIn invite
flagged.detail: New connection — worth a note if he sits anywhere near your board and governance track.

flagged.title: Mike forwarded a contact-form submission
flagged.detail: Came from Michael Campanaro's campanaro.io site — a glance when you have a minute.

inbox.noise: Care.com applicants, an Apple receipt, the Todoist digest, and a stack of travel and language newsletters.
inbox.clear: The Aug 24–Sep 3 Airbnb host thread wrapped up — nothing owed.

resolved.title: Airbnb host thread closed out
resolved.detail: The Heart of Kenwood host exchange (Aug 24–Sep 3) ended on a friendly note — Mike handled it, nothing owed.

recipe.title: Composed summer salad with french feta
recipe.why: High summer means peak tomatoes, cucumbers, and herbs — a composed salad lets them shine without a stove.

tasks.title: Call dermatologist to book the removal appt
Book the Sept 19 Cavtat night plus transfers
Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip

acts.line: One appointment at 9:30, then a stack of calls to make in a single sitting — pediatrician, cell plan, dermatologist.
Nothing scheduled; the hours are yours for the Croatia and Orlando booking backlog.
The girls are home with you and Mike in St Pete — a quiet one.
